xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4509: Docs lint: fail on dollar signs that Mintlify renders as math, and bare less-than before a digit

plan.title: Docs lint: fail on dollar signs that Mintlify renders as math, and bare less-than before a digit
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Mintlify renders a pair of $ on a line as LaTeX math, and on a line with inline code it does so even for \$. Model prices rendered as formula glyphs until hand-fixed to $ (commits 2050875, bb8ffba). Nothing in npm run lint or CI catches a regression. A bare < before a digit also breaks strict MDX. Four published lines on main fail the rule today (guides/legacy-codebases.mdx:95-97, reference/token-spend-report.mdx:93).
narratives.Proposal: Extend the existing but unwired scripts/lint-docs.js with an exported findMdxProblems(content) scanner (any $ or \$ and any <digit in prose fails; fenced code, inline code and frontmatter are skipped), a docs.json navigation walk over every published page, and a --root flag. Keep its old docs/*.md checks. Wire it as lint:docs at the end of the npm run lint chain (it lands in the CI core lint group automatically via run-lint-group.mjs). Fix the four offending lines with $. Document the rule in docs/RELEASING.md's changelog section. Full detail and the scanner code are in the PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4509.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Checking unpublished .mdx files or snippets/*.mdx
- Checking YAML frontmatter
- Special-casing JSX expressions, JSX attribute strings or {/* */} comments
- An opt-out marker for intentional LaTeX
- Multi-line inline code spans (spans are matched within one line)
- Any other MDX validation (unclosed tags, broken links)
- Changing the existing docs/*.md empty-file and trailing-newline checks
- Editing scripts/run-lint-group.mjs or .github/workflows/ci.yml

autoDecisions.summary: Extend scripts/lint-docs.js instead of creating a new lint script.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the existing docs lint home, unwired today, and its old docs/*.md checks pass on main (node scripts/lint-docs.js exits 0), so wiring it adds them back to CI at no cost.

autoDecisions.summary: Fail on any $ in prose, not only pairs.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue proposes 'any $ or \$'; a single $ becomes a pair as soon as a second price lands on the line, so the rule must not count.
Frontmatter is not MDX prose; $ there would appear as a literal entity in page metadata.

autoDecisions.summary: No opt-out marker and no JSX/comment special-casing.
autoDecisions.rationale: No published page uses real LaTeX and no JSX or comment on a published page contains $ today; adding exemptions would be speculative.

autoDecisions.summary: The page set is the docs.json navigation walk; a listed page with no file is an error.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scopes the rule to every page listed in docs.json; a missing file would otherwise be silently skipped.

autoDecisions.summary: Wire as lint:docs appended to the lint chain without touching CI config.
autoDecisions.rationale: scripts/run-lint-group.mjs puts every step not in HEAVY_STEPS into the core CI group, so CI picks it up automatically.

items.title: Exported MDX prose scanner in scripts/lint-docs.js with string-fixture tests

expected_outputs: tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts passes with all findMdxProblems cases green

narrative.Action: PRD W1 steps 1, 2 and the findMdxProblems part of step 5. Restructure scripts/lint-docs.js so its existing top-level docs/*.md checks move behind an isMain guard (pattern: scripts/windows-smoke/summarize.mjs line 175, const isMain = process.argv[1] && fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === process.argv[1]). Keep the old checks' behavior identical. Add a header comment citing PAN-4509 and commits 2050875/bb8ffba explaining Mintlify math pairing and why $ and < are the fixes. Export stripInlineCode(line) and findMdxProblems(content) exactly as specified in the PRD code block (DOLLAR_MESSAGE 'dollar sign in prose renders as math on Mintlify — write $ instead', LT_DIGIT_MESSAGE 'bare "<" before a digit breaks strict MDX — write < instead'; returns {line, message}[], 1-based lines, one message per rule per line). Create tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts importing these from '../../../scripts/lint-docs.js' (precedent: tests/unit/scripts/windows-smoke-summarize.test.ts) with cases: prose $2/M, escaped \$2/M, single $54,116, $2/M, inline `$HOME`, double-backtick span containing $, $ in prose on a line that also has inline code, backtick fence with $ npm i, fence indented inside <Steps>, tilde fence, frontmatter description with $, <3 retries, <3, 'a < 3', and correct line numbers in multi-line content. Tests use string fixtures only; never read real repo pages; no skipIf/.only.

items.title: Given content with $2/M, \$2/M or a single $54,116 in prose, findMdxProblems returns one problem at that 1-based line whose message contains $
Given $ only inside a backtick fence, an indented fence, a tilde fence, a single- or double-backtick inline code span, or frontmatter, findMdxProblems returns an empty array
Given a prose line '<3 retries', findMdxProblems returns a problem whose message contains <; given '<3' or 'a < 3' or '$2' it returns none
Importing scripts/lint-docs.js from the test does not run the docs/*.md checks or call process.exit (the isMain guard holds), and npx vitest run tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts exits 0
docs.json published-page walk and --root CLI in scripts/lint-docs.js with tmpdir CLI tests

expected_outputs: tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts passes including the CLI fixture cases
node scripts/lint-docs.js --root . prints file:line problems only for the four known currency lines until the fix-currency item lands, and exits 0 after it

narrative.Action: PRD W1 steps 3, 4 and the CLI part of step 5. Export collectPublishedPages(docsJson): recursively collect every string reached under docsJson.navigation through tabs, groups and pages arrays, where a pages entry may be a { group, pages } object. Under isMain: parse --root <dir> (default process.cwd()); run the existing docs/*.md checks against <root>/docs unchanged; read <root>/docs.json, collect pages, resolve each to <root>/<path>.mdx else <root>/<path>.md; a page with neither prints 'docs.json lists "<path>" but no <path>.mdx or <path>.md exists'; run findMdxProblems on each file and print '<relative path>:<line>: <message>' via console.error. Exit 1 on any error; on success print 'docs lint passed (<n> docs files, <m> published pages)'. In tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts add: a collectPublishedPages test with a nested { group, pages } object; CLI tests modeled on tests/unit/scripts/lint-dist-externals.test.ts (mkdtempSync root, afterEach rmSync, execFileSync node SCRIPT --root root): bad.mdx with 'Price: $2/M' on line 3 listed in docs.json plus docs/ok.md ending in a newline -> exit status 1 and stderr contains 'bad.mdx:3:' and '$'; clean fixture -> exit 0; docs.json listing a missing page -> exit 1 and stderr names the page.

Given a clean tmpdir root (docs/ok.md ending in a newline, published pages with $ only), the CLI exits 0 and prints 'docs lint passed'
Given docs.json listing a page with no .mdx or .md file, the CLI exits 1 and stderr names that page path
collectPublishedPages returns page strings from a pages array that contains a nested { group, pages } object, in document order

Add lint:docs to package.json and append it to the npm run lint chain

expected_outputs: npm run lint:docs exits 0 and prints 'docs lint passed'
the core line of --list output includes 'npm run lint:docs'

narrative.Action: PRD W3. In package.json add the script "lint:docs": "node scripts/lint-docs.js" beside the other lint:* scripts, and append ' && npm run lint:docs' to the very end of the lint script (line 114, after npm run lint:effect-diagnostics). Do not edit scripts/run-lint-group.mjs or .github/workflows/ci.yml: any step not in its HEAVY_STEPS map runs in the core CI lint group automatically. Requires the scanner and cli items (the script must have the new checks) and fix-currency (main must pass before the gate turns on).

node scripts/run-lint-group.mjs --list prints 'npm run lint:docs' on the core line, and the package.json lint script ends with '&& npm run lint:docs'
Given a temporary local edit adding '$2/M' to a prose line of changelog.mdx, npm run lint:docs exits 1 and names changelog.mdx with the line number and $ (edit reverted afterwards, not committed)
Document the $ and < rule in docs/RELEASING.md's changelog section

expected_outputs: a line in the 'Update the public changelog' section mentions $, < and npm run lint:docs

narrative.Action: PRD W4. In docs/RELEASING.md, section '## Update the public changelog' (line 118), extend step 1 (drafting the entries) with: write every currency dollar as $ (for example $2/M input) and every < before a digit as <, because Mintlify renders paired $ as math (even escaped as \$ on a line with inline code) and strict MDX rejects < before a digit; npm run lint:docs, part of npm run lint and CI, fails on either. Inside RELEASING.md write the entities in inline code (`$`, `<`) so the rendered markdown shows them literally.

items.title: Step 1 of the 'Update the public changelog' section in docs/RELEASING.md contains the instruction to write currency as $ and < before a digit as <
